info.title: Linket
info.description:
In the documentation API requests will be sent from currently logged in user so you do not need to provide a bearer token manually.

When calling API from outside the documentation, you will need to provide an access token for all requests in authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer `
You can create a new access token in your account settings page.
